protocol.question: At the same extra HBM budget, do concentrated, distributed, replicated and hybrid layouts produce different real source use and recovery costs?
protocol.observed_metric: synthetic data-fill wall = prepare_s + execute_wall_s; verified-publication wall includes SHA and is reported separately; not SGLang T_ready
protocol.gate: scientific performance outcome remains inconclusive if spread/gain is comparable to repeated baseline variation; no full-model gain claim
safety: separate container/mesh, no calls that mutate protected worker sessions
allow only known low-memory background keepers; GPU use below 4GiB, at least 12GiB free
require free-only NUMA headroom for own base and initialization scratch
limits: synthetic functional execution comparison is an e3 precursor; full model primary-metric acceptance remains for e5
co-resident keeper contexts and any interference are recorded; no exclusive-hardware claim
protocol.revision_reason: Original run failed free-only NUMA admission before worker startup. Reduce rank size from 2GiB to 256MiB; retain layout ratios; per-source initialization scratch equal to rank size and 512MiB free-page guard.
